description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The Naval Nuclear Laboratory’s Information Technology Department seeks an entry-level Software Developer to support custom and low-code application development. The role contributes to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of business applications while collaborating with senior developers and stakeholders.
Associate Entry-Level Software Developer building and maintaining business applications, workflows, integrations, and custom features across low-code and traditional platforms

Responsibilities:
• The Entry-Level Software Developer supports the design, development, testing, and maintenance of business applications using both low-code platforms and traditional programming languages
• This role assists with building workflows, forms, dashboards, integrations, and custom application features based on user and business requirements
• The developer collaborates with senior developers and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, document solutions, and follow established coding, security, and quality standards

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in a related field; or
• Master's degree from an accredited college or university in a related field
• All candidates must be U.S. citizens
• must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter

Preferred:
• Familiarity with software development fundamentals, including variables, data structures, debugging, testing, and version control
• Exposure to low-code/no-code development platforms (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow) or a willingness to learn them
• Basic understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, REST APIs, JSON, and client-server architecture
• Understanding of secure coding practices, access controls, data handling, and software quality principles
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document solutions and work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders
• Willingness to learn new platforms, tools, development standards, and business processes in a structured team environment
